caseStudy.intro: We recently supported {client}, a municipal political party in Lévis, Québec, through a comprehensive public opinion analysis and field strategy process.

Setting up a real-time dashboard to track the data as it came in
Training the party's volunteers in voter identification (canvassing) techniques

Strategic recommendations based on these insights

The custom survey, the real-time dashboard and the training of our volunteers greatly strengthened our work on the ground. The strategic analyses and recommendations were clear, relevant and immediately useful. A professional and efficient service from start to finish.

people.name: Hubert Cadieux
bio: Hubert Cadieux is a data scientist and the founder of Opubliq. Holding a master's degree in political science from Université Laval, he turns public opinion into concrete strategies using machine learning and quantitative analysis.

The author of several academic publications and a recipient of a Fonds de recherche du Québec scholarship, he has contributed to projects such as Datagotchi, Boussole électorale and Polimètre, and develops advanced analytics tools for businesses, non-profits, and political and public organizations.

people.name: Alexandre Bouillon
bio: A co-founder of Opubliq, Alexandre holds a master's degree in political science from Université Laval and is a PhD student in political science at Université de Montréal. Specializing in electoral behaviour and data analysis, he is particularly interested in new methods of data collection and visualization.
Through Opubliq, he draws on his expertise in computational social science to equip political actors and help democratize public opinion within civil society.

people.name: Nicolas Ebnoether-Noel
bio: A co-founder of Opubliq, Nicolas Ebnoether-Noel holds a bachelor's degree in history and has more than a decade of experience in polling, public opinion analysis and strategic targeting.
He has worked with a wide range of political, institutional and community organizations to define and implement optimization strategies grounded in data analysis.

about.title: About Opubliq
about.lead: Opubliq inc. is a Québec-based company specializing in public opinion data analysis. We turn data into strategic action to help organizations understand and navigate public opinion.
body: We work with public and para-public organizations — municipalities, non-profits, labour unions, political parties and public affairs agencies — through the analysis of existing data, turnkey surveys and strategic support.

Opubliq also develops technology products, including a self-serve survey platform and, in the longer term, an AI-based platform for estimating public opinion that stems from our research and development work.
